rows.name: Insert · blocks-expanded — [not-implemented] the thumbnails. shared/types/block.ts:25 declares preview?: string and nothing sets it: grep -rn preview packages/editor/src/blocks/ returns zero, so all 50 cards fall through to an empty 136x80 grey rectangle under an 11px label (GroupSection.tsx:234-262, UX-A-05). DESIGN-AHEAD: the picture grid is kept here as the target for when previews exist; the shipping drawing is the sibling Insert · blocks-expanded · rows. BLOCKS cards are also not draggable — only ELEMENTS passes draggable (UX-A-06). UX-A-28: three of these 50 — Product Card, Product Grid, Product Detail — start a data-modelling flow on insert and nothing on the card says so. useComposerInit.ts:735-763 listens for ELEMENT_INSERTED and opens the CMS collection-setup modal over the editor; hasPromptedForCollectionRef is set BEFORE the async collection lookup (:744-746), so one dismissal is permanent and the block is left bound to no collection with no route back to the offer.
